asr_text: Elle listed mini bags as one of the trends in fall and winter 2026 fashion. Its examples included the fashion label Kite's palm-sized evening clutch and Chanel's novelty minaudière. They mainly hold the basics—a phone, wallet, keys, and lip products. They do not challenge roomy bags on storage. Their job is visual, adding a sense of occasion and saying, this is today's mood. The season's picture becomes clearer when we look at what appeared beside them.
